name: Applied Nutrition Plc
summary: Applied Nutrition Plc engages in the manufacture, wholesale, and retail of sports nutritional, and health and wellness products in the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally. It offers whey protein, isolate protein, beef protein, vegan protein, clear protein, mass gainers, casein/night-time protein, and diet whey protein; pre-workout powders, pre-workout cans, caffeine-free pre-workouts, pre-workout shots, and pre-workout gels; creatine powder, creatine performance supplements, creatine gummies and chews, creatine fizz tablets, and creatine capsules; and hydration stick packs, hydration fizz tablets, hydration powders, hydration gels, and hydration drinks.
